description: This file is a shell script for testing the behavior of GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES, including setting environment variables, creating symbolic links, and testing directory prefixes in various scenarios. It includes test cases and checks specific to Git's directory ceiling functionality.

methods.name: test_prefix
methods.description: Checks if the current directory prefix matches the expected value by comparing the output of 'git rev-parse --show-prefix' with the expected string.

methods.name: test_fail
methods.description: Verifies that certain GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES settings cause 'git rev-parse --show-prefix' to fail with an error code.
